content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness; it says the witness-left-unanswered ground fails.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"every witness pressed against C3 was named and answered in the challenger's own later rounds","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.","room":"counts as an unanswered witness: whether the rule governs any discussion of unanswered witnesses or only an actual count; the text does not count any verse as unanswered","why":"The judge text rejects the witness-left-unanswered ground and does not count any verse as an unanswered witness, so it does not violate K-G4."}
